:::{.definition data-title="Norm"}

For [[vector-space-linear-space|vector space]] $V$ on [[field|field]]
$\mathbb{R}$ a **norm** is a function $||\cdot||:V\rightarrow\mathbb{R}$
satisfying the following properties for $v,x\in V$:
1. $\Vert v\Vert \geq 0~\forall v\in V$
2. $||v||=0$ iff $v=0$
3. $\Vert\alpha v \Vert =|\alpha|\Vert v\Vert$ for $\alpha\in\mathbb{R}$
4. $\Vert v+z\Vert\leq \Vert v\Vert + \Vert x \Vert$ (triangle inequality)

:::
